'''Killee-Kor''' was a small city on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. It was built throughout rocky cliffs and mesas in the [[Killee Wasteland]] such as [[Sarlacc's Peak]], where the ''[[Crimson Axe]]'' was located. It was a place of impressive underworld activity.
